---

- These slides explain why evaluating a causal forest's treatment-effect ranking with the area under the targeting operator characteristic curve (AUTOC) requires a held-out sample. They illustrate the dependence that remains with out-of-bag predictions and include a simulation comparing same-sample and held-out evaluation.
